name: xamarin-maui-check
description: Xamarin to .NET MAUI migration check: reads the solutions, old-style and SDK-style projects, packages.config, C# and XAML files of a Xamarin.Forms, Xamarin.Android or Xamarin.iOS solution as text, builds nothing, and lists what must change to move it to .NET MAUI: projects to convert to SDK-style, platform heads that become Platforms folders, Xamarin target frameworks, Xamarin-era packages and what replaces them, packages with no known equivalent, custom renderers, effects, DependencyService, MessagingCenter, the Device class, Xamarin.Forms namespaces in C# and XAML and layouts .NET MAUI does not carry over, with file and line, a summary and an effort score per area. Text, JSON, CSV and GitHub annotation output, exit codes for a pipeline, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
